title: A2-19 · ‎إِنَّand the particles of his family

blocks.text: A2-19 · ⁧إِنَّ⁩ and the particles of his family
Lesson overview

"In truth the language is culture" , "he said it will come," "but the problem is..." , "as if it were..." , "maybe I had time!" , "maybe it will come": a group of particles " ⁧إِنَّ⁩ , ⁧أَنَّ⁩ , ⁧لٰكِنَّ⁩ , ⁧لِأَنَّ⁩ , ⁧كَأَنَّ⁩ , ⁧لَيْتَ⁩ , ⁧لَعَلَّ⁩ The following subject goes to the accusative (or is a suffix pronoun), the predicate remains at the name. ⁧أَنَّ⁩ and ⁧لِأَنَّ⁩ You know them from A2-14; here complete the family, learn why after ⁧قَالَ⁩ is used ⁧إِنَّ⁩ , and use these particles to express opinions, hopes and impressions. From the Unit A2-19 notices, titles and reading texts are without vowels or almost; dialogues and examples remain vocalized. A week.

blocks.text: Materials This unit, Anki deck A2 (tag A2-19), script for speech synthesis, session with tutor
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. use ⁧إِنَّ⁩ and its sisters with the subject of accusation or suffixes ( ⁧إِنَّهُ⁩ , ⁧لٰكِنَّنِي⁩ , ⁧لَعَلَّكَ⁩ );
2. report a sentence with ⁧قَالَ إِنَّ⁩ and distinguish ⁧إِنَّ⁩ / ⁧أَنَّ⁩ / ⁧إِنْ⁩ / ⁧أَنْ⁩ ;
3. put the prepositional predicate before the subject ( ⁧إِنَّ فِي البَيْتِ رَجُلًا⁩ );
4. recognise ⁧لَا⁩ of absolute denial ( ⁧لَا شَكَّ⁩ , ⁧لَا بَأْسَ⁩ );
5. express an opinion, hope, desire and impression, and read a short editorial without

Friday night, shift's over. We're three weeks from Luca's departure.

What to notice. ⁧لٰكِنَّنِي⁩ , ⁧لٰكِنَّ الأُذُنَ⁩ , ⁧إِنَّ أَوَّلَ أُسْبُوعٍ⁩ , ⁧لَعَلَّهَا⁩ , ⁧لَيْتَنِي⁩ , ⁧كَأَنَّكَ⁩ : all particles are followed by a name to the accusative ( ⁧الأُذُنَ⁩ , ⁧أَوَّلَ⁩ ) or from a suffix. ⁧تَقُولُ إِنَّنِي⁩ : after ... say... the ... ⁧إِنَّ⁩ (Section 4). ⁧أَلَّا⁩ = ⁧أَنْ⁩ + ⁧لَا⁩ Not further worked than hot-rolled, hot-drawn or cold-rolled (cold-reduced) and not further worked than hot-rolled, hot-drawn or cold-rolled, in irregularly wound coils ⁧بِصَرَاحَةٍ⁩ "Honestly' ⁧تَتَعَوَّدُ⁩ (V) get used to it, ⁧سَتَلِدُ⁩ It will give birth to the child (A2-15: ⁧وَلَدَ يَلِدُ⁩ ), ⁧مَبْرُوك⁩ Congratulations (answered) ⁧اللهُ يُبَارِكُ فِيكَ⁩ ), ⁧القَمَر⁩ The Moon is the Moon. ⁧مِنْ كَثْرَةِ مَا⁩ ... since how long... ⁧وَأَنَا أَتَكَلَّمُ⁩ I have to say that I am in favour of the Commission's proposal. ⁧وَ⁩ + pronoun describes the status (A2-20).
2. The family of ⁧إِنَّ⁩

rows: as if work were a game
I wish the job was easy!

blocks.text: ⁧لَعَلَّ⁩ Perhaps (hope or supposition) ⁧لَعَلَّ العَمَلَ سَهْلٌ.⁩ Maybe the job is easy. The rule. After these particles the subject ( ⁧المُبْتَدَأ⁩ ) goes to the accusative, the predicate ( ⁧الخَبَر⁩ ) remains at the name: ⁧العَمَلُ صَعْبٌ⁩ → ⁧إِنَّ العَمَلَ صَعْبٌ⁩ . With healthy plurals and duals you can also see without vowels: ⁧إِنَّ المُوَظَّفِينَ مَشْغُولُونَ⁩ The staff are employed. ⁧لَعَلَّ الطَّالِبَيْنِ فِي المَكْتَبَةِ⁩ . ⁧إِنَّ⁩ At the beginning of the sentence, it emphasizes (-- really, certainly) and is heard in speeches, formal texts, declarations. It doesn't often translate into English. ⁧لٰكِنْ⁩ and ⁧لٰكِنَّ⁩ . ⁧لٰكِنْ⁩ (without shadda) is a simple conjunction and can be followed by any sentence, even verbal ( ⁧لٰكِنْ لَمْ يَأْتِ⁩ ); ⁧لٰكِنَّ⁩ wants a name to the accused or a suffix ( ⁧لٰكِنَّهُ لَمْ يَأْتِ⁩ ). The sense is the same. ⁧لَيْتَ⁩ and ⁧لَعَلَّ⁩ . ⁧لَيْتَ⁩ expresses a desire that is often unrealizable: ⁧لَيْتَ الصَّيْفَ طَوِيلٌ⁩ Maybe the summer was long. ⁧لَيْتَنِي كُنْتُ هُنَاكَ⁩ I wish I'd been there. ⁧لَعَلَّ⁩ expresses a hope or assumption: ⁧لَعَلَّكَ تَعِبٌ⁩ "Maybe you're tired" ⁧لَعَلَّهُ يَأْتِي غَدًا⁩ We hope it will come tomorrow.
3. With suffix pronouns

Both the long form ( ⁧إِنَّنِي⁩ , ⁧لٰكِنَّنِي⁩ ) and the short ( ⁧إِنِّي⁩ , ⁧لٰكِنِّي⁩ ). The pronoun of the situation is given. When after the particle comes a verb, you put the suffix ⁧ـهُ⁩ , which refers to nothing in particular: ⁧إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنَ السَّهْلِ⁩ ... is not easy... ⁧قَالَ إِنَّهُ سَيُسَافِرُ⁩ "He said he will leave" (here ⁧ـهُ⁩ It may also be "He").
4. ⁧قَالَ إِنَّ⁩ : report a sentence
After ⁧قَالَ⁩ and its forms ( ⁧يَقُولُ⁩ , ⁧قُلْ⁩ , ⁧قِيلَ⁩ , ⁧يُقَالُ⁩ ) the "he" is ⁧إِنَّ⁩ , ⁧أَنَّ⁩ :

rows: ⁧قَالَ إِنَّ الدَّرْسَ صَعْبٌ.⁩ He said that the lesson is difficult.
⁧قَالَتْ إِنَّهَا مَرِيضَةٌ.⁩ She said she was sick.

With other verbs to say it is used. ⁧أَنَّ⁩ : ⁧أَكَّدَ أَنَّ⁩ It confirmed that the Union industry was not in a position to compete with the Union industry. ⁧ذَكَرَ أَنَّ⁩ ... he mentioned that, ⁧أَعْلَنَ أَنَّ⁩ , ⁧صَرَّحَ بِأَنَّ⁩ "The Commission has stated that it is in favour of the Commission's proposal. The news is full of these formulas (A2-20 This is the subject of the report. People change, times don't. In Arabic the speech reported maintains the time of direct discourse: ⁧قَالَ إِنَّهُ مَرِيضٌ⁩ "He said he was sick" (Lett. "Who is sick" is the word. In Italian you adapt the weather. Four similar words.

rows: Of, of, of, of or of a conjunction with

blocks.text: No vowels ⁧إن⁩ and ⁧أن⁩ are distinguished from the hamza (above or below the alif) and from what follows.
5. The order of words
If the predicate is a preposition + name or adverb, it may come before the subject; the subject remains to the accused:

rows: There's a man in the house.
I wish we had more time!
But there's a friend with him.

blocks.text: Attention: here the subject is indeterminate and accused ( ⁧رَجُلًا⁩ , ⁧سُؤَالًا⁩ , ⁧وَقْتًا⁩ ), with the alif of tanwīn.
6. ⁧لَا⁩ of absolute denial (recognize)
Another word has a similar effect: ⁧لَا⁩ + name indefinite to the accused without tanwīn denies in absolute way (.......).................................................

⁧لَا مُشْكِلَةَ.⁩ No problem. They are mainly fixed formulas: they are unheard of as blocks. Necessary and possible. Need expressions are used ⁧مِنَ⁩ + adjective + ⁧أَنْ⁩ : ⁧مِنَ الضَّرُورِيِّ أَنْ تَأْتِيَ⁩ You need to be there, ⁧لَيْسَ مِنَ الضَّرُورِيِّ أَنْ⁩ ... is not necessary to...A2-04), ⁧مِنَ المُمْكِنِ أَنْ⁩ It is possible that the following information may be provided: ⁧مِنَ المُسْتَحِيلِ أَنْ⁩ It is impossible that it should be, ⁧مِنَ الطَّبِيعِيِّ أَنْ⁩ It's normal that it is.
7. Pronunciation

Double. inna, anna, lākinna, laʿalla, kaʾanna: the double consonant can be heard. With the suffixes: in-na-hu, lā-kin- na-nī, la-ʿal-la-hu. laytanī, laʿallī. ⁧ليتني⁩ and ⁧لعلّي⁩ : Attention to the short form ⁧لَعَلِّي⁩ ( la-ʿal-lī). The accuser after the particle. inna l-ʿamala ṣaʿbun: in the reading with terminations the accusative of the subject is heard; in the pause reading it remains only in the alif of tanwīn ( ⁧إِنَّ عِنْدِي سُؤَالًا⁩ : suʾālā).

blocks.text: Notes of use. ⁧أَتَمَنَّى⁩ is the verb of greetings: ⁧أَتَمَنَّى لَكَ رِحْلَةً سَعِيدَةً⁩ I wish you a good trip. ⁧أَتَمَنَّى أَنْ⁩ ... I hope that, I hope that it will. ⁧آمُلُ أَنْ⁩ is more formal (letters, speeches). ⁧يُؤْمِنُ بِـ⁩ • believe in (an idea, a person, God); for believing that it is used ⁧أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ⁩ ( A2-14). ⁧تَصْرِيح⁩ is the "Declaration" of a spokesman ( ⁧تَصْرِيحَاتُ الوَزِيرِ⁩ ) and, in an administrative context, the permit, authorisation ( ⁧تَصْرِيحُ عَمَلٍ⁩ • Work permit (s). ⁧حَقِيقَة⁩ : ⁧فِي الحَقِيقَةِ⁩ In fact, it does not. ⁧الحَقِيقَةُ أَنَّ⁩ ... the truth is that...
